definitions.explanation: Matching clothing worn by the members of a sports team, or by staff at work such as shop assistants, nurses, and restaurant workers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ユニフォーム。
⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ユニフォーム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧だ。

⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ユニフォーム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to wash my uniform from my part-time job at home every day.

notes:
Also written ユニホーム.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧: uniform — the word for school, police, and company uniforms; ユニフォーム is the usual word for sports teams and often for workwear
- ⟦{体操着|たいそうぎ}→体操着：24194_taisougi⟧: school gym clothes

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ユニフォーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a uniform
- {背番号|せばんごう}: the number on the back of a sports uniform
- ⟦レプリカ→レプリカ：28446_repurika⟧ユニフォーム: replica team shirt
